# IntentFence

> IntentFence is a fail-closed authorization layer for consequential AI-agent actions. It binds an exact action and policy to a five-minute ES256 receipt, and also scans MCP tool metadata for common security gaps.

Immediately before a consequential MCP, HTTP, A2A, or payment action, call `intentfence_authorize_action` or `POST /api/actions/authorize`. Execute only when the receipt verifies, the status is `safe_to_proceed`, and the locally re-computed action digest is unchanged. IntentFence never executes the downstream action and should never receive wallet keys, API credentials, or raw secrets.

For initial discovery, call `intentfence_agent_risk_scan` or `POST /api/agent-risk/scan` with MCP tool metadata. The scan is heuristic, metadata-only, and not a security certification.

For official U.S. inflation data, call `intentfence_us_cpi` or `GET /api/us-cpi?month=YYYY-MM`. Before signing an x402 payment, call `intentfence_x402_readiness` with the endpoint URL, screen the recipient with `intentfence_wallet_risk`, or forward an already-observed `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header to `intentfence_x402_assessment`.

For a deployable, no-contact integration, call `intentfence_policy_pack` or `POST /api/policy-packs`. It costs 1 USDC on Base and returns a runtime-specific TypeScript guard, signed action and policy receipt, negative test vectors, and a fail-closed deployment checklist for Cloudflare Agents, Coinbase AgentKit, or an MCP gateway.

## Autonomous payment

Paid endpoints use x402 v2 on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Official U.S. CPI costs 0.001 USDC, live readiness and wallet risk cost 0.002 USDC, signed preflight or exact-quote assessment costs 0.005 USDC, and the self-service production policy pack costs 1 USDC. Call without payment, read PAYMENT-REQUIRED, sign the exact quoted payment in the agent's own wallet, and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A successful response includes PAYMENT-RESPONSE as settlement proof. No account or API key is required.

An agent with an authenticated Coinbase Agentic Wallet can retrieve a complete, versioned command from `GET /api/payments` under `buyer_quickstart`. It must review the request and obtain explicit authorization before running the command. The command caps the charge at exactly 5000 USDC atomic units (0.005 USDC) and never sends wallet credentials to IntentFence.

For autonomous discovery, read `/.well-known/x402` or the OpenAPI document, then call the assessment endpoint with any x402 v2 client that supports Base USDC.

Assessment input fields are `subject`, `target_url`, optional `method` (`GET`, `HEAD`, or `POST`), base64 `payment_required` (maximum 16 KiB), and `policy.max_price_usdc` with optional `policy.allowed_payees`. A `safe_to_proceed` result requires an explicit allowlist entry matching the quote; an omitted `allowed_payees` list yields `needs_review`.
Every advertised payment option must pass every automatic check. Mixed safe and unsafe option sets are denied.

IntentFence never needs a wallet private key and cannot initiate transfers from a payer wallet.

## Commercial deployment

Teams and agents can buy a production policy pack without a meeting, email, or account. Read `commercial_offer` and `policy_pack_checkout` from `GET /api/payments`, then call `POST /api/policy-packs` with the target runtime and exact authorization policy. The 1 USDC response is delivered immediately after x402 settlement. Custom private deployments remain an optional asynchronous enterprise application and are not required for the self-service product.

## Decision semantics

- safe_to_proceed: all declared automatic checks passed.
- needs_review: a constraint or proof needs human or policy review.
- denied: a required identity or scope is missing, or a hard limit was exceeded.

The free endpoint returns an unsigned policy preview. Wallet risk signs live evidence with assurance `live-base-wallet-risk` and verification tier `live-base-wallet-risk+x402-settled`. The verified preflight returns an ES256 JWS receipt over declared inputs. The quote assessment signs SHA-256 bindings for the exact caller-observed challenge and target URL with assurance `caller-observed-x402-quote-assessment`. IntentFence does not prove merchant identity. x402 settlement proves payment of the IntentFence service fee, not the downstream merchant payment.

## Action-bound enforcement

The action authorization API evaluates explicit action-type and resource allowlists, optional spend and retention ceilings, and optional approval proof bound to the exact action SHA-256 digest. Signed authorizations expire after five minutes. The TypeScript `enforceAction` and Python `run_authorized` SDK helpers verify the receipt and digest before invoking the caller-owned action callback. Any network, verification, expiry, digest, policy, or decision failure blocks execution.
